description: Start an evaluation run for a test set (draft agent by default, or the published one). Optionally wait for completion and return the summary. mcsConnectionId runs it signed in as a user profile (the id of that user's Copilot Studio connection) so authenticated knowledge and tools answer; toolsConnections picks the connection each connector tool uses. Counts against the 20 runs per agent per 24h limit: requires confirm: true.

botId.description: Agent (bot) id. Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_AGENT_ID.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

environmentId.description: Power Platform environment id (GUID). Defaults to workspace sync metadata or CPS_ENVIRONMENT_ID.

mcsConnectionId.description: Copilot Studio connection id of the user profile to run as; omit for an anonymous run. Power Automate > Connections > Microsoft Copilot Studio, the GUID in the URL

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

toolsConnections.description: Which connection each connector tool should use during the run

botId.description: Dataverse bot id; default: the evaluated agent

connectionId.description: The user connection to run it with (cs_list_connections)

connectionReferenceName.description: Connection reference name in the agent, when the tool is bound through one

workspace.description: Path to (or inside) the agent workspace. Defaults to CPS_WORKSPACE or the current directory.

name: cs_run_evaluation
title: Run an evaluation
